statement: ∀ (w v ρ : ℝ) (d : ℕ), 0 < w → 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 → 0 < d → ρ*w ≤ v → (Real.log w + Real.log ρ)/d ≤ Real.log v/d

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0036 · 从一般可测区域的相对测度恢复体积下界
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0036 · Recover a volume floor from the density of a measurable region

brief.en: Use ρ=μ(C∩W)/μ(W). The measured region may be any measurable set.
